newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-TENDULKAR AND GANGULY IN RECORD STAND.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-TENDULKAR AND GANGULY IN RECORD STAND.

text.p: Sachin Tendulkar and Saurav Ganguly completed a record fifth wicket stand of 150 for India against Sri Lanka in the second and final test on Monday.
The pair helped India to 297 for five at lunch on the third day in reply to Sri Lanka's first innings of 332.

India, resuming at 226 for four, lost the solitary wicket of Tendulkar for 139 in the morning session but left-hander Ganguly was unbeaten on 86 at the interval, having batted 278 minuwtes and hit 11 fours.
Tendulkar and Ganguly beat the previous best fifth wicket stand by India in tests against Sri Lanka of 87 between Mohammad Azharuddin and Sanjay Manjrekar at Bangalore in 1993-94.
Sri Lanka took the second new ball at the start of the morning but had to wait for 25 minutes before lunch to achieve a breakthrough.

Tendulkar, dropped at 34 the pevious day by Sri Lankan captain Arjuna Ranatunga, was brilliantly caught by a diving Muthiah Muralitharan at extra cover as India's captain drove powerfully at pace bowler Ravindra Pushpakumara.
Tendulkar batted 403 minutes and faced 266 balls, hitting 16 fours, while Ganguly reached his half-century in 166 minutes off 124 balls with seven fours.
